description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll a check or saving throw.

Turn a failure into a success before it's finalized.

You may declare this feat before the degree of success is determined. If the result would be a failure (not a critical failure), treat it as a success instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Declare before the degree is known; if it would be a (non-critical) failure, treat it as a success instead" is P-DEGREE-REACTIVE: even though declared before the roll, the adjustment depends on the roll's own outcome (only fires on failure specifically), which AdjustDegreeOfSuccess's predicate -- evaluated in beforePrepareData, before the check resolves -- has no way to condition on.
